Switching between two operating modes (petrol and LPG)

When the ignition is turned ON, all the LEDs in the SEDIMO device remain on for around 4 seconds for a diagnostic function.

For reasons connected with the fault diagnosis of the PETROL pump supply cut out relay, the PETROL operation warning light goes off with a certain delay when starting up on PETROL and then switching to LPG.

In the case of quick starting, the signalling of the LEDs indicating the operating mode may overlap with the component diagnostic function (all the LEDs coming on for 4 seconds after the ignition has been turned ON).
